name: Commerce Cart Links
description: Build links whose URL adds product(s) to a customer's Drupal Commerce cart and optionally empties/deletes it, applies a coupon, and redirects.
project_description: Commerce Cart Links lets you construct links that manipulate a customer's Drupal Commerce shopping cart through the URL. A link to /cart-links/57-2/384-1 adds 2 of purchasable-entity 57 and 1 of 384 to the cart, then redirects to the cart page (or a destination). Query parameters control the behavior: existing=new|empty|delete manages the customer's current cart, store=# forces a store, default_entity_type / a per-product third hyphen segment override the purchasable entity type, destination=/path sets the post-processing redirect, and coupon_code=# applies a promotion coupon. Prices, order type and product validity are resolved server-side from the loaded entities; the URL supplies only entity IDs, quantities and options. Access to /cart-links is gated by a custom access check that validates the query parameters, checks the request referer against an optional admin-configured allowlist, and requires the 'view commerce cart links' permission. The module also ships a 'Share cart' feature: a views area button and modal (CartLinksBuilder service) that generate a shareable /cart-links URL representing the current cart, gated by the 'generate cart share links' permission. A typical use case is checkout links from ad channels such as Google Merchant Center that drop the advertised product straight into the shopper's cart.
